topic: From four STORM prompts to an evidence-governed research skill
research_question: What must be added to a four-prompt STORM-inspired workflow before it can produce auditable deep research in Markdown, HTML, and PDF?
user_goal: Design and verify a reusable anti-hallucination research skill
audience: Agent-skill authors and advanced AI research users
decision_context: Decide whether prompt chaining is sufficient for trustworthy reusable research
timeframe: STORM evidence published in 2024 and implementation state retrieved in 2026
assumptions: The target is a reusable Library skill, not a one-off briefing prompt.
